usage: deskops next [-h] [--root ROOT] [--diagram] [--why] [task_id]

positional arguments:
  task_id      Task selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.
  --diagram    Render the workflow state machine as Mermaid from its source spec.
  --why        Explain why this task and these actions were selected.

Examples:
  deskops next task-fix-thing --root .
  deskops next --diagram
